summary: Prioritize AI use cases, assess business cases and plan governance in five days. Explore the AI strategy training course and its practical outputs.
lede: AI strategy helps leaders assess AI opportunities and connect investment to business priorities, ownership and measurable outcomes. For strategy, transformation and AI programme professionals, this course covers screening use cases, assessing data readiness and building investment cases that account for costs, benefits and operational capacity. You also practise mapping governance and risk responsibilities, setting outcome measures and decision gates, and sequencing initiatives into a roadmap.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape, evaluate or govern AI investments and need to connect use-case decisions with operational capacity, risk ownership and business outcomes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business strategy, business cases or data-driven initiatives is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on strategy decisions, governance and planning artefacts.
